description: Updates for the CLI, the docs site, the templates and their add-ons. CI creates games with every option on each update, so an update merges only when every option still works.

customManagers.description: TypeScript add-ons pin their npm packages in cli/template/typescript/extras/**/addon.json
The Luau template and its add-ons pin their Wally packages, exactly (`scope/name@=1.2.3`), in wally.toml and cli/template/luau/extras/**/addon.json

mise's own version: this repository's workflows' jdx/mise-action `version:` and the templates' cloud setup, which a game's workflows read. Grouped into one update; .github/scripts/check-mise-pins.ts then fails until cloud-setup.sh's SHA-256s match the new release.

packageRules.description: Released fixes for the dev tools we rely on come in at once, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAgeExclude allows
Patch and minor updates merge themselves once CI, with every created game, passes; majors wait for a person

Never merged without a person: the tools above come in on release day, before any wait could catch a hijacked release, and CI's engine job runs them with the Open Cloud key; and a Rojo update needs a check that CI can't make, that rbx-forge supports its Studio plugin
mise's own version moves in one update, merged by a person once cloud-setup.sh's SHA-256s are updated
Wally's registry gives no release dates, so the two-week wait can't hold back a fresh release of a Roblox package: it shows up at once, and a person merges it
